title: The daily trial's twists
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.name: Moon's Embrace
items.desc: Elite enemies gather under the blood moon, each one carries more than usual.

items.name: Shattered Resolve
items.desc: Every strike echoes; expect to bleed more.

items.name: Vermin's Feast
items.desc: Expect to fight more, but each is a trifle less formidable.

items.name: Tough Skins
items.desc: Expect richer spoils, but every scratch feels like a bite of iron.

items.name: Swift Shadows
items.desc: They'll be upon you before you know it.

items.name: Qi Overflow
items.desc: Gather twice as much qi, but beware the influx of other cultivators drawn by the excess.

items.name: Unyielding Wounds
items.desc: Expect every cut and gash to linger, healing as slowly as the dawn.

items.name: Warrior's Pride
items.desc: Each opponent fights like a seasoned cultivator, demanding tactics and patience.
